name: Extravagant Order: Tharynn Bouden is a quest giver again and takes the order back (#6129)
contract: Quest 17001 Extravagant Order is started and ended by Tharynn Bouden 66 (rev_20260923_01 starter and ender rows), and its objective names him. rev_20260930_98 replaced his template with npcflag 128 (vendor only), so the server prepared no quest menu and the order could not be handed in. rev_20261003_10 restored the quest-giver bit (npcflag 130). Expected: with the quest complete, talking to Tharynn lists 17001 in his quest menu.
